scope: original x86 instruction reference only; no executable process launch
query_scope: actual FirstHashIndex; row matching independently modeled using genuine bytes

first_hash_index.branch_semantics: signed CMP/JGE; equal hashes move end to midpoint; no hash subtraction

branch_semantics.unequal_hashes: signed CMP EDX,ECX; SETGE AL; return2*AL-1 (no hash subtraction/overflow)
branch_semantics.equal_hashes: signed16 cell indices; IDIV columnCount; return indexA%columns-indexB%columns
branch_semantics.stable_row_tie: No row comparison when hash and column agree; qsort stability not promised

original_qsort.limitations: Caller proves nonnull storage, positive stride, valid comparator; invalid-input CRT services not executed by locator.
